links.outcome: Respondent-rated understandability of GPT-generated versus standard ED discharge instructions by subsection
links.effect: GPT-generated instructions were rated more understandable for procedures, treatment, medications, follow-up, and return precautions; the Wilcoxon test was significant (P=.01) only for return precautions, and other sections were noninferior.
links.quote: Survey respondents found GPT-generated instructions to be more understandable when rating procedures, treatment, post-ED medications or medication changes, post-ED follow-up, and return precautions.

screen.reason: The study evaluated patient perceptions (via MTurk crowd workers acting as proxy patients) of GPT-4-generated ED discharge instructions compared to standard instructions across simulated cases.
